frame.caption: Cell — a preset, or "custom" with its diameter and length below
frame.name: CELL

frame.caption: Diameter (mm) — the cell's body; 0 takes the preset's
frame.name: CELL_D

frame.caption: Length (mm) — the cell's body, end face to end face; 0 takes the preset's
frame.name: CELL_L

frame.caption: Fit offset (mm) — how much bigger your printer and cells make the grip need to be: find it with the coupon set
frame.name: FIT_OFFSET

frame.caption: Gap between cells (mm) — between neighbouring cells' bodies; 0.8 is the closest the printed holes allow
frame.name: CELL_GAP

frame.caption: Pitch (mm) — centre to centre, overriding diameter + gap: set it when your busbars or strip fix it; 0 to leave it
frame.name: PITCH

frame.caption: Cells across — the block's columns
frame.name: NC

frame.caption: Cells deep — the block's rows
frame.name: NR

frame.caption: Printer size (mm) — the build volume's smallest side: 270 for a Snapmaker U1
frame.name: PRINT_MAX

frame.caption: Waves per cell — along the wall: 1 puts a crest at each cell's middle and a vent by each gap between cells
frame.name: WAVES_PER_CELL

frame.caption: Vent shape — the along-the-wall wave's share of the depth: 0.5 round vents; toward 0.7 tall slots; under 0.35 thin columns
frame.name: ALONG_SHARE

frame.caption: Wave height (mm) — how far apart the waves up the frame stand: shorter, more and smaller vents; each crest touches the cells
frame.name: UP_WAVELENGTH

frame.caption: Wave position (degrees) — where the waves up the frame fall: 90 spaces the contact lines evenly, 0 the vents
frame.name: UP_PHASE

frame.caption: Stagger — each cell's shift of the waves up the frame: 0.5 staggers the vents like brick, 0 lines them up in rows
frame.name: STAGGER

frame.caption: Trough depth (mm) — how far the wall stands off the cells between contacts: deeper, bigger vents and air channels
frame.name: CHANNEL

frame.caption: Crest press (mm) — how far the crests reach into the cells' land, which trims them: the contact patches' size
frame.name: CREST_PRESS

frame.caption: Mirror — how far the outside follows the inside's wave: 1 fully, opening the most; less, a thicker wall, smaller vents
frame.name: MIRROR

frame.caption: Grip — where the edge cells' bow springs sit: auto takes the gap between cells where a bow fits, else the wall
frame.name: GRIP

frame.caption: Bow length (mm) — a bow spring's span between its roots: 8 is tested, and the longest drawn
frame.name: BOW_SPAN

frame.caption: Shortest bow (mm) — the shortest drawn; shorter, it is too stiff to spring. Untested below 8
frame.name: BOW_SPAN_MIN

frame.caption: Bow thickness (mm) — two lines of a 0.4 mm nozzle
frame.name: BOW_T

frame.caption: Bow press (mm) — how far the bows' middles stand inside the cell, on diameter: more grips harder
frame.name: TIP_PRESS

frame.caption: Bore clearance (mm) — the hole round the bows, past the cell, on diameter: a plain hole this size is a bit loose
frame.name: BORE_CLR

frame.caption: Thinnest neck (mm) — the narrowest plastic between two neighbouring pockets: four lines
frame.name: NECK_MIN

frame.caption: Thinnest arm tip (mm) — where an arm between two cells is cut: thinner won't print as a wall
frame.name: ARM_TIP_W

frame.caption: Frame land clearance (mm) — the frame round each cell, on diameter: a block of cells slides in without binding
frame.name: FRAME_LAND_CLR

frame.caption: Shortest tie (mm) — the solid across the wall between two vents one above the other
frame.name: TIE_MIN

frame.caption: Narrowest column — the solid between two vents side by side, as a share of the along-the-wall wavelength
frame.name: COLUMN_SHARE

frame.caption: Least open — the share of the wall between the bands that must open: less, and the vents are slivers
frame.name: OPEN_MIN

frame.caption: Wall thickness (mm) — in the bands of bows: eight lines
frame.name: WALL_T

frame.caption: Bump depth (mm) — the bumps on the outside behind each cell, where the wall is otherwise plain
frame.name: BUMP_DEPTH

frame.caption: Band height (mm) — each band of bows near the ends: short, to leave more of the frame to the vents
frame.name: BAND_H

frame.caption: End clearance (mm) — the frame stops this far short of each end of the cells, clear of terminals and busbars
frame.name: END_CLR
